passage: The old post office downtown was torn down last year after it closed. Next summer, the city ______ a new public library on the same site.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
steps: The other choices are past or present perfect forms.
key: Let time words (next, last, since) choose the tense.
